title: Broad exception caught at 2 sites (L79,L122)
detail: `except Exception` without re-raise swallows unexpected errors silently. Suggested fix: catch only known exception types from the callee.

title: Exception context suppressed: 1 raise without `from` (L80)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback. Suggested fix: add `from exc` or `from None`.

title: Bare `raise` in non-except scope at L178 — depends on caller holding active exception
detail: Function `_handle_key_manager_error_forbidden` uses a bare `raise` at L178 to re-raise the caller's active exception. If ever called outside an exception handler, this raises `RuntimeError: No active exception to re-raise`. The design relies on an invisible invariant with no enforcement or documentation. Suggested fix: pass the exception explicitly as a parameter and raise it directly.
